purpose: reader-facing explanation of the six CRISP-DM phases using an AI-assisted classifieds listing example

required_facts.fact: CRISP-DM remains a useful reference for AI engineering despite modern use of LLM APIs, retrieval, agents, prompts, evaluation, and observability.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 1-8: changed tools and continuing process mapping are stated.

required_facts.fact: The example feature suggests listing fields from a photo on an online classifieds platform.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 22-29: listing fields and photo-based feature are described.

required_facts.fact: Business Understanding defines the problem and measurable criteria, such as listing time and abandonment targets.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 32-38: objectives and AI suitability are explained.

required_facts.fact: Data Understanding examines image storage, formats, resolutions, frequency, quality, and related titles, descriptions, and categories.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 40-51: data questions and contextual fields are listed.

required_facts.fact: Data Preparation validates and normalizes images, prepares category metadata, and defines generated-attribute output formats.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 53-64: preparation tasks and RAG preparation examples are described.

required_facts.fact: Modeling shifts toward system design around a foundation model, including prompts, schemas, validation, and extraction tests.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 66-81: modeling tasks and experimentation are specified.

required_facts.fact: Evaluation checks whether an AI-assisted workflow improves original goals such as creation time and abandonment.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 83-94: A/B comparison and return to earlier phases are stated.

required_facts.fact: Deployment connects the service to backend systems, handles errors and unexpected input, and monitors performance and product metrics.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 96-108: deployment responsibilities are listed.

required_facts.fact: Production discoveries can send the team back to data preparation, modeling, or evaluation.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 110-114: iterative nature of the lifecycle is explicit.

required_facts.fact: The framework connects product objectives to technical decisions throughout the AI system lifecycle.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 34-38 and 85-108: business criteria recur through evaluation and deployment.

author_attribution: Explain the source's historical framework mapping and retain the hypothetical nature of the classifieds feature and its example metrics.
